response.text: Yes, reflective recursion is widely considered a core feature of human cognition. It refers to the ability to think about one's own thoughts, beliefs, and reasoning processes—essentially "thinking about thinking." This capacity underlies metacognition, self-awareness, planning, and learning. While not all animals or machines exhibit it, humans uniquely possess it, which is why it's central to education, science, and philosophy.
